verdict.rationale: Pigment documents its own reporting on the live planning model: the Analyst Agent builds reports from conversations, variance analysis runs on the same platform as the budget and flags the reasons behind gaps, and KPI and dashboard tooling exists. The evidence never shows an assembled board pack or presentation output, so the story is only partly delivered. Missing for 10: documented board-pack or slide/deck generation or export, explicit auto-generated written variance commentary, a packaged forecast section in the report, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate a board pack (metrics, variance commentary, forecast) from the live model instead of assembling slides by hand

citations.quote: The Analyst Agent continuously monitors your business, uncovers what matters and builds reports from simple conversations
Run variance analysis on the same platform you build your budget. Understand and flag the reasons behind identified gaps
you can also set up KPI. For example, as we have here, projected year end cash.
Discover how to turn data into insights with Pigment's reporting tools, visualization tips, and expert advice on building clear, compelling dashboards.
